SELECT MIN(l.CreationDate) AS first_link, MAX(l.CreationDate) AS last_link,
       COUNT(*) AS links, COUNT(p.Id) AS matched_targets,
       COUNT(p.AnswerCount) AS known_answer_counts,
       MIN(p.AnswerCount) AS min_answers, MAX(p.AnswerCount) AS max_answers
FROM main.postLinks AS l
LEFT JOIN main.posts AS p ON p.Id = l.RelatedPostId
WHERE l.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01' AND l.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'

WITH RECURSIVE months(month_start) AS (
    SELECT '2010-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
    FROM months
    WHERE month_start < '2010-12-01'
),
monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT m.month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT p.Id) AS post_count
    FROM months AS m
    LEFT JOIN main.postLinks AS l
        ON l.CreationDate >= m.month_start
       AND l.CreationDate < date(m.month_start, '+1 month')
    LEFT JOIN main.posts AS p
        ON p.Id = l.RelatedPostId
       AND p.AnswerCount <= 2
    GROUP BY m.month_start
)
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', month_start) AS month,
       post_count,
       ROUND(AVG(post_count) OVER (), 2) AS average_monthly_posts
FROM monthly_counts
ORDER BY month_start
LIMIT 12
